children.text: Architected a multi-tiered Google Ads Search structure segmented by treatment category and intent level. Built a 250+ negative keyword library to filter out general queries, employment searches, and DIY medical questions. Configured primary conversion actions in Google Tag Manager for verified form submits and phone calls with 60+ seconds duration.

In local healthcare paid search, negative keyword hygiene and call tracking verification matter just as much as ad copy. Feeding only qualified booking events into Google Ads bidding algorithms prevents automated bidding from pursuing cheap, irrelevant clicks.
